seo.description: The exterior design of OK PRIME Shirokane-Takanawa: nichokake brick tiles, stone textures, Spanish-style paving and the interplay of light and shadow create a calm, enduring Urban Classic presence. Designed by Meiho Archilabo. Property information by WinnerLife.
seo.ogImageAlt: OK PRIME Shirokane-Takanawa Urban Classic building exterior

hero.title: Architecture
hero.subtitle: A timeless facade, built on a thousand years of craftsmanship

intro.heading: Artisan craftsmanship meets modern building technology
intro.body: At OK PRIME Shirokane-Takanawa, every material — from the exterior tiles to the coating system — reflects an uncompromising commitment to quality. We've chosen Japan's highest-grade building materials and centuries-old craftsmanship to create a central Tokyo asset that only gets better with time.

highlights.title: Authentic Mino-yaki heritage — a treasured Japanese craft over 1,000 years in the making
highlights.body: Mino-yaki ceramics have a history of more than 1,300 years and are officially designated a Traditional Craft by the Japanese government. Chōkō Tōgyō has taken this kiln-firing technique, once reserved for fine tea ware and tableware, and adapted it perfectly for modern exterior tiles. By bringing the wabi-sabi aesthetic of the Japanese tea ceremony to the facade, your home gains more character the longer you live in it.

highlights.title: An exclusive 5:9:4 golden blend — depth and dimension, precisely mixed by artisans
highlights.body: Artisans precisely mix three shades of deep gray — dark, medium and light — in a perfect 5:9:4 ratio and lay them in a random mesh-backed pattern. In natural light at different times of day, or after a rain shower, the wall reveals remarkably subtle depth and texture. It's a quiet kind of luxury that instantly elevates the entire building.

highlights.title: Top-grade Class BI porcelain — durability built for extreme climates
highlights.body: These tiles are classified as Class BI (porcelain), the top grade with the lowest water absorption (typically under 1%) and the highest firing temperature (over 1,200°C). The catalog specifically rates them "Frost Resistance ◎" — proven even in Japan's coldest regions — so in milder climates they keep the facade looking new for 30 years, saving significantly on exterior cleaning and maintenance.

highlights.title: 45 Nichokake Flanca (mesh-backed) — handcrafted texture with efficient installation
highlights.body: The 45 Nichokake Flanca series uses the classic nichokake proportions of Japanese architecture to create refined lines. Supplied on mesh backing, it keeps the fine detail of small tiles while making on-site installation much faster and more even.

advantages.title: Product Advantages
advantages.subtitle: Building material performance that stands the test of time

items.title: Exceptional Durability
items.body: A cross-linked coating with siloxane bonds effectively resists UV rays, moisture and other causes of polymer aging, protecting the building's exterior for the long term.

items.title: Superior Stain Resistance
items.body: The dense cross-linked coating keeps airborne dust and exhaust fumes from sticking, delivering outstanding resistance to dirt.

items.title: Mold & Algae Resistant
items.body: A special formulation prevents mold, algae and other microbial growth over the long term, keeping the building's surfaces clean and hygienic.

items.title: Eco-Friendly & Safe
items.body: A water-based paint (thinned with water) with no risk of solvent poisoning or fire, making the job site safer for workers.

items.title: Boosts Asset Value
items.body: More durable than conventional acrylic or polyurethane paints, with a lower overall life-cycle cost that helps raise the building's asset value.

items.title: Distinctive Look & Feel
items.body: A richly textured, dimensional surface paired with a pearlescent glaze with its own unique sheen creates visual depth and material beauty that's hard to replicate.

bubbles: Our tiles are Mino-yaki, a traditional Japanese craft with 1,300 years of kiln-firing heritage.
The exterior tiles are top-grade Class BI porcelain — under 1% water absorption and extremely durable.
A 5:9:4 golden blend gives the walls subtle depth in every kind of light.

paragraphs: Combining style and practicality, Bellaz Neo makes your daily routine more comfortable in a modern city home.

The pull-out hand shower makes everyday cleaning easy and even lets you wash your hair at the sink, while the adjustable faucet adapts to whatever you need. The extra-large basin adds convenience, so you can get ready without rushing even on busy mornings.
Generous storage underneath keeps all your toiletries neatly organized and the space clean and uncluttered. Thoughtful details create a bathroom that truly fits the way you live.

features.subtitle: Easy Cleaning
features.body: The flat floor has no noticeable ridges, so it drains extremely well, and the seamless one-piece design from floor to tub leaves nowhere for grime to hide — a quick scrub with a sponge is all it takes. A touch-free hair catcher uses the flow of water to gather hair naturally, making drain cleaning hygienic and easy.

features.title: Friendly, Safe, Barrier-Free Design
features.subtitle: Safe Bathing
features.body: The bathroom entrance has a low, nearly flat threshold that helps prevent older family members and small children from tripping. The tub's step-over height is lowered to about 450 mm, with a handy spot to lean on, helping you stay balanced and safe as you get in and out.

features.title: Comfort Meets Energy Efficiency
features.subtitle: Relaxing Soaks, Water & Energy Savings
features.body: The tub leaves plenty of room for your shoulders and includes a handrail, keeping soaks comfortable while using about 45 liters less water than a conventional tub. A water-saving showerhead with a special flow design and a highly insulated tub that keeps water warm longer mean less reheating, cutting utility bills and CO₂ emissions.

items.question: Do I still need home security if the building has an auto-lock entrance?
items.answer: An auto-lock entrance alone can't stop someone from slipping in behind a resident or delivery person. With ALSOK home security, if something unusual happens, a guard is dispatched to the scene, takes appropriate action and then reports back to you.

items.question: What are the main amenities around Shirokane-Takanawa?
items.answer: Within walking distance you'll find the Shirokane Aer City mixed-use complex, Takanawa Gateway City, multiple stations including Shirokane-Takanawa, Mita and Tamachi, green spaces like Shiba Park, plus supermarkets, banks and medical facilities — everything you need day to day.

items.question: What's the current state of redevelopment in Shirokane-Takanawa?
items.answer: Shirokane-Takanawa is undergoing large-scale urban renewal. Landmarks like SHIROKANE The SKY and TAKANAWA GATEWAY CITY have been completed one after another, and shops, offices and everyday services keep improving, steadily raising the value of the area.

items.question: How can I book a viewing to learn about the neighborhood?
items.answer: Book a viewing through our website, and the WinnerLife team will walk you through the amenities, transit access and investment details around OK PRIME+ Shirokane-Takanawa (5-5-10 Mita, Minato-ku).
